title: Quantitative Uniqueness and Rough Damping on $\mathbb T^2$
summary: Motivated by a conjecture of Burq and Gérard, we investigate quantitative uniqueness principles for functions on $\mathbb T^2$ whose Fourier spectra lie in fixed-width annuli. We obtain observability estimates uniform in the radius, under a mild Sobolev regularity condition, and the generalized geometric control condition (GGCC) on the damping function. This leads to exponential decay for the damped wave equation with rough damping.
